Package frc.robot.subsystems.drivetrain.gyro

Class NavX

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.subsystems.drivetrain.gyro.GyroIO
frc.robot.subsystems.drivetrain.gyro.NavX
public class NavX extends GyroIO
NavX gyro implementation of GyroIO.

Interfaces with the NavX gyro sensor to provide heading and angular velocity data. Uses a separate thread to read gyro data at a fixed rate for improved responsiveness.
